basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of Visitacion Valley, this cozy and charming single-family residence features 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, additional bonus room, and a bright, open layout with large windows and tasteful modern touches. The home invites your creative vision whether you're looking to restore its original character or update it with contemporary finishes. Enjoy a well-appointed kitchen, a private backyard ideal for entertaining or relaxing, and a location that offers both comfort and convenience. You're just minutes from local shops, restaurants, parks, and public transit, making city living a breeze.    Perfectly positioned in a vibrant neighborhood, this home offers endless potential and is a rare find in today's market. Schedule your visit today and imagine the possibilities!
